gh "pr" "create" "-R" "cv/pit" "--base" "main" "--head" "release-0.36.3" "--title" "fix(input): decode JSON string literal params; release v0.36.3" "--body" "Fixes #368 and releases v0.36.3.

- `resolveToolInput` (`src/tool/input.ts`) decodes a `params` string that is a JSON string literal for every declared input, so a program with a string input gets real line breaks instead of quotes and `\n` escapes. A quoted string that is not valid JSON passes through unchanged. This is the patch from the issue, plus tests for an unannotated input with surrounding whitespace and for a lone quote. `docs/reference.md` describes the new behavior.
- Release commit: adds a `## [0.36.3]` changelog entry, bumps `package.json` and `package-lock.json` to 0.36.3, and points the README's pinned install example at `v0.36.3`.

The two commits are meant to land separately (rebase merge). After that, tag the release commit `v0.36.3` on `main`.

`delivery.validate` passes (check, tests, coverage, package check). `npm audit --omit=dev` finds 0 vulnerabilities. `npm pack --dry-run`: 183 files, 319.8 kB."
